description: a single bare deciduous tree with NO leaves, thick warm brown trunk with dark brown bark and tan highlights, buttressed roots flaring out at the base and ending cleanly with nothing beneath them, the trunk rises and forks into two strong limbs which branch into a spread of bare twigs, storybook game pixel art, dark outline, the tree floats on a completely empty transparent background: NO soil, NO dirt patch, NO grass, NO ground disc, NO shadow, NO tile, NO border, one tree only
